text:
PagerDuty: INC-2026-045 triggered for service=runtime-eu. Symptom: sustained 5xx spike from eu-central-1a (error_rate ~ 28% over 90s). Pager: @oncall-eu.
incident-bot: Running automated triage: collecting recent logs, node health, LB status, route tables.
incident-bot: Quick findings: 3/12 app pods in eu-central-1a in CrashLoopBackOff, node ip-10-0-7-34 NotReady. External ALB 5xx ratio 0.27.
SRE Bot: Alert snapshot saved to /incidents/1845678901/snapshot-1845678901.tgz
Ryan O.: Acked. I'm on it — will grab the node + kube logs. Assigning P1 for now.
Alex M.: Confirming — seeing same in Datadog. 95th latency up to 1.6s and 5xx up across all routes terminating in eu-central-1a.
Samira: Any customer-facing impact? CX reports 2 customers with errors via support. Tagging @sales-alerts.
Chris L.: ETA on mitigation? If it's node-level we should fail traffic to other AZs and spin up replacements.
Ryan O.: Running quick node check now:
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep eu-central-1a
kubectl describe node ip-10-0-7-34
journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 --no-pager
```
Ryan O.: Node shows disk pressure and kubelet restarted twice in last 5m. Could be host-level networking flap.
Alex M.: I'm going to enable fallback routing: shift ALB target weights away from eu-central-1a to eu-central-1b/c. Dry-run first.
Alex M.: Dry-run output:
```
./tools/reroute --lb runtime-eu-alb --from-zone eu-central-1a --to-zones eu-central-1b,eu-central-1c --weight 0.1 --dry-run
# result: would reduce traffic to 8% to 1a, increase to 46%/46% to 1b/1c
```
Alex M.: Executing now.
Alex M.: /tools/reroute executed: new weights applied. Confirming ALB health checks...
incident-bot: ALB target weights updated. 5xx rate in eu-central-1a traffic slice dropping (expected).
SRE Bot: Monitoring rollout: error rate aggregated across region dropping to 9% within 60s.
PagerDuty: INC-2026-045 acknowledged by Ryan O. (on-call).
Samira: Notifying affected customers: filing incident page for support + posting ETA to status.redwood.ai. Drafted message in #support-incidents.
Chris L.: K8s autoscaler failed to spin new pods in 1b due to quota. I'm increasing pod quota in eu-central-1b now.
Chris L.: Quota bump applied. HPA now scaling up, new pods becoming Ready.
Ryan O.: I'm collecting kube logs and will cordon + drain the failing node ip-10-0-7-34.
Ryan O.: Commands:
```
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-7-34
kubectl drain ip-10-0-7-34 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Ryan O.: Node drained. Pods rescheduled to 1b/1c.
Alex M.: Confirming end-to-end test for runtime-eu: POST /v1/generate — successful from eu-central-1b after reroute.
Samira: Severity set to P1 and incident bridge created: https://meet.redwood.ai/bridges/INC-2026-045
Samira: Notifying Legal/Compliance as requested by enterprise customers.
Chris L.: Filing postmortem checklist item: check NAT gateway stability in eu-central-1a, host OS update history, kernel logs.
Ryan O.: Handing off to Alex for next 45m — I'll stay reachable via DM. Alex, take lead on remediation and rollback plan.
Alex M.: Taking over. Current state: traffic shifted, error rate region-wide down to 3.4%, 5xx in 1a specifically down to 7%. Working on root cause: investigating host-level networking flaps + possible upstream NIC driver update.
PagerDuty: Escalation policy: will notify infra-leads in 10m if error rate > 5% persists.
SRE Bot: Running extended checks (KV cache hit ratio, prefix cache validity) — no regressions observed there.
Samira: Customer comms posted to status.redwood.ai: "We are experiencing degraded performance in eu-central-1a; traffic is being routed to alternate availability zones. Engineers are investigating."

Chris L.: If 1a remains unstable we'll consider evacuation and reprovisioning of instances. Preparing ASG lifecycle scripts.
Alex M.: Logging scheduled maintenance windows to avoid conflicts. Will attach full logs to the Jira incident: RD-INC-2026-045.
Samira: I'll coordinate a follow-up with affected customers after we have RCA.
Ryan O.: Closing immediate pager response loop. I'll mark PagerDuty acknowledgment and set a follow-up update at +30m.
Alex M.: Noted. Continuing root cause analysis. Will post final update here and in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
